references.label: Center drop target
references.description: Central drop whose displayed award builds from 100 through 500 before changing to Special.

references.label: Lit rollover buttons
references.description: Five upper and two lower lit buttons that each advance the center-target value by 100.

references.label: A-B swinging targets
references.description: Two swinging targets that advance the center award and raise the target again after a collect.

references.label: Lit top bumper
references.description: Upper bumper worth 100 when lit and the other primary points route.

references.label: Center triangular wedge
references.description: Upward-pointing wedge between the wide-set flippers that can deflect a center ball toward either flipper.
